[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Greatest sum divisible by three** [LC 1262 · Greatest Sum Divisible by Three](https://leetcode.com/problems/greatest-sum-divisible-by-three/){difficulty="Medium"}

The sum's remainder modulo 3 is the only fact a later decision needs. Three running totals, one per remainder, remember the best sum that produced that remainder. Taking $x$ sends remainder $r$ to $(r + x) \bmod 3$ and adds $x$. The empty sum is remainder 0 with total 0. The other two remainders start unreachable, not at 0: 0 would claim you already have a sum of 0 in that class.

[Solved in full in @sec-lis-p5-mod3.]{.card-link}

:::
